repoDescription: Total Recall brain — Node ESM, no TypeScript, no ESLint. Quality here means: dist stays in sync with src, the open-source path invariant holds, and the SSSS reference kernel still passes its own suites.

checks.description: Published dist must not lag src — prepublishOnly depends on this.
INVARIANT: TR core must never hardcode a personal home path or name a third-party product repo. Multi-repo support is path-only (register/track/--repo/TR_SYNC_REPOS/cwd).

patterns.message: Hardcoded absolute home path. Derive from os.homedir(), cwd, or config.
Hardcoded ~/Github path. Use project-registry / TR_SYNC_REPOS / --repo / cwd.
Names a third-party product repo. TR is open-source: host apps are equal implementations, never special-cased.

checks.description: SSSS effective-registry verification via the shipped @ssss/cli (v0.9).
Full vitest suite. Heavy — prefer the Mac Mini or droplet over the laptop.
